name: Sage Fusion
source:
Set in a futuristic universe in which artificial intelligence is considered religious taboo, Sage Fusion tells the adventure of a businessman and his bodyguard who visit the planet of Capistad, the capital of the galaxy where two major political powers are centered: the liberal government and the fanatical church. What the two men don't know is that they're about to be caught up in a conflict between these two powers.

[Taken from [URL=https://kidalang.itch.io/sage-fusion]itch.io[/URL]]
translation:
《贤者融合》以人工智能被视为宗教禁忌的未来宇宙为背景，讲述了一位商人和他的保镖访问卡皮斯塔星球的冒险经历，卡皮斯塔星球是银河系的首都，那里集中了两个主要政治势力：自由政府和狂热教会。两人不知道的是，他们即将陷入两种势力之间的冲突。

[摘自[URL=https://kidalang.itch.io/sage-fusion]itch.io[/URL]]
